items.title: PowerOptions opened an RFP for a utility bill management platform serving 800+ member organizations
items.description: PowerOptions is soliciting qualified providers to deliver a utility bill management platform for its consortium members. The organization says it serves more than 800 nonprofit and public-sector members across Massachusetts, Rhode Island, Maine and Connecticut. The RFP was distributed September 11 and proposals are due October 16, 2026 at 5:00 p.m. EST.
why: October 16 proposal deadline provides a workable pursuit window

items.title: Worcester opened a two-year workers compensation and IOD administration RFP
items.business: City of Worcester Executive Office of Human Resources
items.description: The City of Worcester opened RFP CR-8812-W7 for professional administration and management of workers compensation and injured-on-duty programs for a two-year period. The bid closes October 14, 2026 at 10:00 a.m.
why: Official City of Worcester RFP opened September 10

items.title: Boston opened an RFP to operate and modernize its coordinated street-furniture program
items.business: City of Boston Property Management Department
items.description: The City of Boston is requesting proposals for a contractor to manage, maintain, expand and modernize its advertising-supported Coordinated Street Furniture Program. The scope includes bus shelters, public toilets, information panels, digital displays, benches and related public-realm amenities. Proposals are due November 4, 2026 at 12:00 p.m. Boston time.
why: Multi-asset program combines physical infrastructure, digital information and ongoing operations

items.title: Cambridge Retirement Board is seeking actuarial services for its $2.1 billion retirement system
items.description: The Cambridge Retirement Board published an RFP for qualified actuarial firms to perform full actuarial valuations, assess whether assets and contributions are sufficient to provide prescribed benefits, and recommend an appropriate funding schedule. The system reports about $2.1 billion in assets and 5,769 participants.

items.title: Massachusetts utilities extended the 1,000 MW energy-storage RFP to October 8
items.business: Eversource, National Grid and Unitil with Massachusetts DOER
items.description: Massachusetts electric distribution companies, coordinated with the Department of Energy Resources, are running Section 83E Round II for long-term contracts covering approximately 1,000 MW of mid-duration energy storage, including a 250-300 MW distribution-connected target.
why: Official competitive RFP for approximately 1,000 MW
Includes a dedicated 250-300 MW distribution-connected procurement target
items.sourceName: Massachusetts Clean Energy / DOER and Distribution Companies

items.title: Shrewsbury SELCO opened Phase 4 of its Fiber-to-the-Premise construction bid
items.business: Town of Shrewsbury / Shrewsbury Electric & Cable Operations (SELCO)
items.description: The Town of Shrewsbury/SELCO posted solicitation BD-25-1324-SELCO-SELCO-131526 for Phase 4 of its Fiber to the Premise project. The scope includes fiber-optic cable installation, splicing and testing. The opportunity was posted September 11 and closes September 29, 2026.
why: Explicit fiber construction, splicing and testing scope
September 29 deadline provides an active pursuit window
items.sourceName: Town of Shrewsbury / SELCO via COMMBUYS (BiddingSimple)

items.title: UMass opened an enterprise master-data-management platform and implementation RFP
items.description: The University of Massachusetts issued RFP UMass-2027-1124 for a SaaS Master Data Management platform and implementation services to modernize enterprise identity mastering across the university system.
why: Enterprise multi-campus software and implementation scope
items.sourceName: University of Massachusetts public bid listing / PublicBidSearch

items.title: Westfield Retirement Board opened a legal-services RFP
items.description: The Westfield Contributory Retirement Board is seeking qualified individuals or firms to provide legal services consistent with Massachusetts General Laws Chapter 32 and PERAC regulations. The RFP was published September 10 and responses are due October 9, 2026 at 1:00 p.m. EST.

items.title: Massachusetts DCR opened a concession RFP to operate the Leo J. Martin Nordic ski facility in Weston
items.business: Massachusetts Department of Conservation and Recreation
items.location: Leo J. Martin Golf Course, Weston, MA
items.description: DCR's current concession-opportunities page lists RFP DCR 2026-800 for operation of the Leo J. Martin-Weston Ski Track. The official RFP describes operation, management, maintenance and commercial programming of the seasonal Nordic ski facility, including trails, snowmaking, grooming, instruction, rentals, retail and events.
why: Official Mass.gov DCR page lists the opportunity as open
Multi-service seasonal concession creates a direct operator opportunity

items.title: FRCOG is seeking a consultant for an EMS operational assessment across 26 Franklin County towns
items.description: FRCOG posted RFP 2026-2196 on COMMBUYS for a qualified consultant to conduct an EMS operational assessment across the 26 towns of Franklin County. The solicitation is open-market and responses are due October 14, 2026 at 2:00 p.m.
why: October 14 deadline provides a workable pursuit window

items.title: Boylston opened general-contractor prequalification for its new Fire Headquarters
items.description: The Town of Boylston posted a COMMBUYS RFQ for General Contractor Prequalification Services for the Town's New Fire Headquarters. The package became available September 11 and qualifications are due September 24, 2026 at 2:00 p.m. through COMMBUYS.
why: Direct prequalification step for a new fire headquarters

items.title: Somerville opened an RFP for its Green and Cool Sustainable Sidewalks and Trees project
items.description: Somerville lists RFP 27-14 as an open procurement for the Green and Cool Somerville: Sustainable Sidewalks and Trees Project. The City classifies the work under environmental planning and management and is accepting proposals through Bid Express until September 23, 2026 at 3:00 p.m.
why: Official Somerville procurement page lists the RFP as open
Environmental planning and management scope is explicit in COMMBUYS

items.title: Boston Fire Department is bidding a technology upgrade
items.business: City of Boston / Boston Fire Department
items.description: The City of Boston posted Event EV00017896 for a Boston Fire Department technology upgrade. The one-year procurement is open electronically through the Supplier Portal and closes September 22, 2026 at 12:00 p.m.
why: Official City of Boston open bid

items.title: Worcester Public Schools is bidding a three-year web-filter SaaS contract
items.business: City of Worcester / Worcester Public Schools
items.description: The City of Worcester lists bid CR-8815-W7 for a three-year SaaS web-filter solution for Worcester Public Schools. The bid is categorized as Information Technology and closes October 7, 2026 at 10:00 a.m.
why: Official City of Worcester open bid

items.title: Lexington is seeking a vendor for a multilingual emergency-preparedness toolkit and community outreach
items.description: Lexington lists RFP 27-30 as open for an Emergency Preparedness Toolkit and Community Connections project. Public solicitation details describe resident-facing preparedness materials, supporting web content, multilingual translation, community engagement, graphic-design coordination and an outreach plan. Proposals are due September 24, 2026 at 12:00 p.m.
why: Official Town bid page lists the RFP as open

items.title: FAA opened a small-business janitorial-services RFP for its Falmouth System Support Center
items.business: Federal Aviation Administration / FMH System Support Center
items.description: The FAA posted solicitation 697DCK-27-R-00004 for janitorial services at the 5,100-square-foot FMH System Support Center, Building 130, at Otis ANGB in Falmouth. The acquisition is a total small-business set-aside and is structured as a firm-fixed-price contract with a base period plus four option years. Offers are due October 20, 2026 at 3:00 p.m. ET.
likelyNeeds: Recurring floor, restroom, window and trash service
why: Total small-business set-aside with base plus four option years
October 20 response deadline and September 29 site visit

items.title: Worcester Public Schools is procuring Motorola emergency radios
items.business: City of Worcester / Worcester Public Schools
items.description: Worcester bid 8818-J7 seeks vendors to furnish and deliver Motorola radios to Worcester Public Schools according to City specifications. The City states that radio programming is not required. The bid closes September 22, 2026 at 4:00 p.m.
why: Official City of Worcester open bid
Defined product requirement with no programming scope

items.title: Boston Public Health Commission is building a qualified consultant vendor pool across four service tracks
items.description: BPHC issued a single RFP to establish a pool of qualified consultants across Communications; Research, Evaluation and Assessment; Strategy and Planning; and Grant Writing. Qualified consultants may be engaged by BPHC programs and bureaus as project needs arise. Responses are due September 30, 2026 at 5:00 p.m.
why: Explicit RFP to establish a qualified consultant pool
items.sourceName: Boston Public Health Commission / City of Boston

items.title: 41 Berkeley Street entered a fresh public-review milestone for a 312-unit mixed-use South End redevelopment
items.description: Boston Planning is holding a September 14 public meeting on the proposed Notice of Project Change for 41 Berkeley Street. The proposal includes approximately 312 residential units across three components, about 8,250 square feet of combined retail/restaurant space, a 93-space below-grade garage and new open space.
why: Official Boston Planning public meeting scheduled September 14
Large mixed-use program is in active Notice of Project Change review
Likely needs are inferred from the development scope; no vendor solicitation is claimed

items.title: Anthropic signed a 24,000-square-foot Kendall Square lease with room to more than double its Cambridge team
items.description: Fresh reporting confirms Anthropic signed a long-term lease for about 24,000 square feet over two floors at One Kendall Square. The company currently has more than 50 Cambridge employees and the new office is planned for roughly 120 workstations. This is an expansion signal only; no public vendor solicitation was identified.
why: Fresh September 11 confirmation of a major Cambridge lease
New office has roughly 120 planned workstations
Expansion may create adjacent fitout and operating needs, but purchasing intent is not confirmed
